verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official JavaScript API that is "fully supported between releases," usable for building plugins in ES6. It also provides first-party tooling around it: skpm for publishing plugins, the sketchtool CLI, and an open .sketch file-format spec on GitHub. However, this SDK surface is scoped to in-app macOS plugins rather than general-purpose SDKs, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: official SDKs in multiple languages, an SDK for a web/cloud API usable outside the Mac app, concrete documentation behind the 'server applications, on any platform' claim, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the API.
